stories.title: Rains damage some 4,000 classrooms
stories.summary:
Rains damage some 4,000 classrooms. MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) said on Monday that some 4,000 classrooms have been damaged by the continuing rains.

The DepEd Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Service said 722 schools have been affected by the inclement weather, with 751 classrooms totally damaged, 818 classrooms sustaining major damage and 2,355 classrooms, minor damage.

stories.title: NBI rescues 9 women in anti-trafficking raid at South Cotabato bar
stories.summary:
NBI rescues 9 women in anti-trafficking raid at South Cotabato bar.

KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Nine females, including a supposed minor, were rescued and two others were arrested during an anti-human trafficking operation here over the weekend, the National Bureau of Investigation – Region 12 (NBI-12) confirmed on Tuesday.

Elias Leaño Jr., NBI-12 Investigation Agent III, said the human trafficking victims were rescued Friday night.
